2947235411.title: Bumbo Toddler Booster Seat (6 Colors)
2947235411.detail_text: Bumbo Toddler Booster Seat is a sturdy booster seat that elevates your toddler to sit more comfortably and safely. This booster seat for toddlers is soft all over and won’t scratch the surface of your furniture. You can easily take the toddler booster seat along to restaurants or when visiting family and friends, as it’s lightweight and easy to carry. Fans of the famous Bumbo Floor seat will love this option for older children, since it's made with the same reliable, durable material. This booster seat is simple to use and maintain. Made of low-density foam, it's easy to clean and highly portable. This soft booster seat rests directly on a regular-sized chair to raise your toddler up to a comfortable height. Includes a three-point harness – This harness helps ensure that your toddler is comfortably secure while sitting in their Bumbo Booster Seat. Fits most standard chairs – Adjustable straps attach to almost all four-legged chairs. Easy-to-clean – Meal times with toddlers can get messy, which is why the Bumbo Booster Seat is made from material that is easy to wipe clean. Lightweight & portable - you can easily take the booster seat along to restaurants or when visiting family and friends Soft yet sturdy - the seat is soft enough to provide comfort but sturdy enough to elevate your toddler to sit more comfortably at the table Won’t scratch furniture - the seat is soft all over therefore won’t scratch the surface of your furniture Dimensions: 12.5 x 13 x 5 inches Seat height boost: 3.5 inches Recommended for babies 18+ months. Always use the attachment straps to secure the toddler booster seat to an adult chair. A 3-point harness is also provided to keep your toddler in place. Download the instruction manual here. Caring for Your Bumbo® Booster Seat The surface of the product has open cells which will act like a sponge through excessive use of water, therefore only use a damp cloth and mild detergent and never immerse the product in water.

brand.name: Britax
brand.suggestion: More Baby Gear & Travel Essentials from Britax

product.highlights:
• Recommended to age 3.5- 12 years old or 15 - 36 kg
  • Redesigned seating area for optimum crash performance to help reduce the neck loads by up to 10%. 
  • Unique protection for the neck and chest- a shock-absorbing foam pad which can prevents the impact of your child's chin on their chest, absorbing up to 30% * of the energy.
  • Advanced Side Impact Protection – SICT- offers superior protection to your child in the event of a side collision.
  • SecureGuard- helps to protect your child’s delicate abdominal area by adding an extra – a 4th – contact point to the 3-point seat belt.
  • Easy adjustable, ergonomic headrest.
  • Carefully placed air ventilation holes aid air circulation to keep your child comfortable for longer..
  • The seat's slim and compact design allows for three seats to be installed in the back row of a wide range of cars..
  • Highback booster protection.
  • Our engineers have used Human Body Model analysis to ensure the seat is designed to be comfortable for both young and older children. Results is better ergonomics, restful rides for all.

13636987902.title: Unilove Feed Me 3-in-1 Dining Booster Seat
13636987902.detail_text: Clean Baby Seating If you're fed up with unclean restaurant high chairs, Feed Me presents an excellent solution. Its double swivel tray simplifies the cleaning process, and the seat pad can be effortlessly removed for cleaning too. Additionally, a travel bag is included in the package for added convenience. Versatile Seating This versatile booster seat is not limited to just dining use, as it can also function as a floor baby seat for infants aged 6 months up to 33 pounds. Additionally, thanks to its adjustable height with four levels, the chair is designed to accommodate the baby as they grow into their toddler years. Compact & Adaptable If you're a parent living in a compact space and looking for a functional and adaptable seating option for your baby, the Feed Me booster seat is the perfect answer. Adapting to any chair with its dual safety belts, converting a standard dining chair into a customized high chair designed exclusively for your little ones.

2677055929.detail_text: The Explore N' Play 5-in-1 Activity Floor to Booster Seat will keep your child comfy and entertained! It includes a rotating 360 degree activity tray that is loaded with STEM-Based toys. Each toy easily removes from the tray and can be used as a standalone and taken on the go. There is also a snack space and cup holder included on the tray. The Explore N' Play can transition to 5 different modes (Floor Seat Entertainer, Activity Seat, Infant Booster Seat, Toddler Booster Seat and Play Mode), perfect for your growing baby. The seat is easy to clean and it includes a removable PU cushion that can be wiped down with ease. A three-point safety harness and bottom secure strap work together to keep little on cozy and safe. Features: Five unique modes are perfect for growing baby! 1. Floor Seat Entertainer Mode 2. Activity Seat Mode 3. Infant Booster Seat Mode 4. Toddler Booster Seat Mode 5. Play Mode (standalone/take along STEM Toys Removable STEM toys capture baby's curiosity and are perfect for on-the-go fun Tray moves 360 degrees, allowing baby to access all toys Tray is separated into four pieces that can be removed independently The activity tray is also able to hold 6 toys and is compatible with select Smart Steps Toys Snack space and cupholder are included on the tray Includes three-point harness for baby and secure strap to safely attach booster to dining chair Comfy foam cushion is easy to clean and removable 2 x AAA batteries Product Specifications: Product Dimensions: 23.25"x 23.25" x 15.38" / 59.05 x 59.05 x 39.06 cm Product Weight: 7.15 lbs / 3.24 kg Recommended Use: Sit upright unassisted 4 m ~ 33lbs / 14.96kg

product.desc:
Help your child sit comfortably and confidently at the dining table, study desk or activity area.

This Kids Chair Cushion Booster Seat Set is designed to increase chair height while providing comfortable back support. The thick high-density foam helps children maintain a better sitting posture and allows them to reach tables more easily.

The removable zippered cover makes cleaning simple, while the anti-slip design and fixing straps help keep the cushion securely in place during use.

Perfect for mealtimes, homework, arts & crafts, reading and everyday activities.

Key Features

Comfortable Height Booster

Raises seating position to help children comfortably reach tables and desks.

High-Density Sponge Filling

Provides firm yet comfortable support without easily flattening.

Back Support Cushion

Supports the back for improved sitting comfort during extended use.

Breathable Fabric

Soft-touch fabric feels gentle on children's skin and remains comfortable throughout the day.

Removable & Washable Cover

Convenient side zipper allows easy removal for cleaning.

Double Anti-Slip Design

  • Anti-slip bottom



  • Adjustable fixing straps



Helps prevent unwanted movement during use.

Multi-Purpose Use

Suitable for:

  • Dining Chairs



  • Study Chairs



  • Reading Corners



  • Activity Tables



  • Play Areas



  • Learning Desks



Specifications

Seat Cushion

  • Size: 40cm × 40cm

  • Thickness: 10cm



Back Cushion

  • Size: 40cm × 40cm

  • Thickness: 5cm



Features:

  • Removable Cover

  • Washable

  • Non-Slip Bottom

  • Adjustable Straps



Benefits for Children

✔ Improves seating height

✔ Better dining posture

✔ More comfortable studying

✔ Helps reduce discomfort from hard chairs

✔ Supports independent sitting

✔ Suitable for home use and childcare settings
product.highlights:

✅ Soft breathable fabric, comfortable for daily use

✅ Suitable for dining, studying, reading and activities

✅ Cute cartoon designs children love

2452400658.detail_text: • Wipeable feeding seat and washable tray for easier cleaning • Safe & secure baby seat for sitting up • Converts from baby booster to toddler seat • Removable tray stores neatly under the booster seat • Mealtime seat for at home or on the go use Description Meals are an important part of family time. The Ingenuity Baby Base 2-in-1 Booster Seat easily attaches to dining chairs so your baby can sit up higher and see more during family dinners. This portable baby feeding seat works just as well sitting with you at the table or as a floor seat during playtime. The removable tray gives your baby her own perfectly sized table so snacks or toys are easily within reach. When not in use the tray conveniently tucks away right underneath the booster seat itself. As your baby grows you can remove the foam seat insert and convert the baby booster into a toddler seat. For all those meals in between you can count on the wipeable seat and dishwasher-safe tray to leave you more time for family catch-up and less for kitchen clean-up. Care Instructions Plastic PartsFoam Insert – Wipe clean with damp cloth and mild soap. Air dry. Do not immerse in water. Tray – Dishwasher Safe. Wipe clean with a soft clean cloth and mild soap. This portable baby feeding seat works just as well sitting with you at the table or as a floor seat during playtime. The removable tray gives your baby her own perfectly sized table so snacks or toys are easily within reach. When not in use the tray conveniently tucks away right underneath the booster seat itself. As your baby grows you can remove the foam seat insert and convert the baby booster into a toddler seat. For all those meals in between you can count on the wipeable seat and dishwasher-safe tray to leave you more time for family catch-up and less for kitchen clean-up. Care Instructions Plastic PartsFoam Insert – Wipe clean with damp cloth and mild soap. Air dry. Do not immerse in water. Tray – Dishwasher Safe. Wipe clean with a soft clean cloth and mild soap. Assembled Dimensions (cm) 43. 82 cm x 38. 74 cm x 29. 85 cm

product.highlights:
The GROMAST Baby Foldable & Portable Travel Dining Booster Seat with Carrying Case is the perfect solution for parents on-the-go.

Easy to Use: This booster seat can be easily attached to any chair, making it the perfect option for dining out or visiting friends and family.

Portable: With its compact design and carrying case, you can take this booster seat anywhere you go without a hassle.

BPA Free: The GROMAST Baby Foldable & Portable Travel Dining Booster Seat is made of BPA free materials, ensuring that your child's safety is always a top priority.

Easy to Clean: The booster seat's surface can be easily wiped down with a damp cloth or sponge making cleanup quick and easy after messy meals.

This baby chair folds up quickly and easily so it won't take up much space in your diaper bag or car trunk. It's also lightweight so carrying it around won't strain your arm muscles! With this portable booster seat, mealtime with baby will always be hassle-free no matter where you are!

13795062901.detail_text: Definitely toxic free with child safe approved features. ️ Beware of similar looking products with non-approved material and safety features. Safety is paramount to our little ones. Design B chair legs are made of high quality stainless steel, guaranteed to last you for years to come. Definitely not some cheaper plastic material. This EN14988-certified baby high chair combines safety, comfort, and convenience for stress-free mealtimes. Made with premium PU leather, it’s easy to wipe clean and gentle on baby’s skin. The multi-position recline, adjustable height, and footrest make it suitable for infants through toddlers. Built-in wheels allow easy mobility, and the 5-point safety harness ensures your little one stays secure. Perfect for feeding, playing, or resting, this high chair grows with your child and fits seamlessly into any modern home. EN14988 standards met for both high chair designs, we have the certifications in place. Do check out the photos for the specifications for Design A and B! :) If you prefer the wheels and reclining feature, please select Design B. Design A (Canary Yellow and Castleton Green) chairs do not come with cushion, seat cover, wheels and reclining features. Design B models come with 3 reclining positions and stainless steels legs. Recommended max weight is 50kg for Design A and 25kg for Design B, though adult weight had been tested on the chair too. Just ensure that the chair is locked into the correct positions before letting the child sit on it.
